parchment-cream.$description: Parchment Cream — Page canvas — the warm off-white that defines the entire site's atmosphere, replacing standard pure-white backgrounds

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

frost-white.$description: Frost White — Alternate light surface for nested elements, subtle nav backgrounds

onyx.$description: Onyx — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, secondary text levels, border accents — the workhorse dark neutral

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted text, sub-labels, less prominent body copy

steel.$description: Steel — Placeholder text, disabled states, low-emphasis labels

silver-border.$description: Silver Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, subtle structural separators

midnight-indigo.$description: Midnight Indigo — Deepest heading text, near-black with cool bias for maximum editorial weight

cobalt-blue.$description: Cobalt Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sapphire.$description: Sapphire — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

terracotta.$description: Terracotta — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

burnt-sienna.$description: Burnt Sienna — Dark terracotta variant for card backgrounds and text on warm sections

peach-glow.$description: Peach Glow — Soft warm wash for highlight panels, accent backgrounds

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

moss.$description: Moss — Secondary green text and border accents on green-themed sections

petal-pink.$description: Petal Pink — Playful accent for tags, category chips, illustration color

marigold.$description: Marigold — Warm accent for badges, tag chips, category highlights

pale-sky.$description: Pale Sky — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation

haas-groot-disp.$description: Display headlines — the custom serif/slab face used for hero statements and large section titles, driven by 900 weight for editorial weight

haas.$description: Body, nav, buttons, subheadings, UI labels — the workhorse sans-serif at 400 for body, 500 for emphasis, 600 for buttons and labels; slight positive tracking opens up at larger sizes
